# VitalityRise — Men's Pelvic Floor Training

VitalityRise (App Store name: Vitality Rise: Men's Health) is an iPhone app for men's pelvic floor training. It runs guided contract-and-relax sessions, pelvic mobility and breathing work, a 30-day plan, and progress scoring. Everything a user enters stays on the device: no account, no cloud sync, no ads. Built by Kyrylo Lozovyi (VITALITY RISE LLC). US pricing: $4.99/week, $9.99/month or $34.99/year (both with a 3-day free trial), or $99.99 once. iOS 17 or later.

It is a general wellness app, not medical care, and does not diagnose or treat erectile dysfunction or any other condition.

## Pages

- [Pelvic floor training for men, done properly](https://www.vitalityrize.me/): A guided pelvic floor trainer for men: timed contract-and-relax sessions, breathing and mobility work, a 30-day plan. Your answers stay on your device.
- [Who builds VitalityRise](https://www.vitalityrize.me/about/): VitalityRise is built by one developer, Kyrylo Lozovyi, trading as VITALITY RISE LLC. No investors, no medical board — and rules the app will not break.
- [Kegel apps for men, compared](https://www.vitalityrize.me/best-kegel-apps-for-men/): Dr. Kegel, Squeezy Men, Kegel Men, Better P, Kegel Trainer and VitalityRise: what each costs and which to pick. Disclosure — we make one of them.
- [Cycling and erectile dysfunction](https://www.vitalityrize.me/cycling-and-erectile-dysfunction/): A study of nearly 4,000 athletes found cyclists no worse off than swimmers or runners. Numbness is the signal that matters, and it is fixable.
- [Dr. Kegel: review and alternatives](https://www.vitalityrize.me/dr-kegel-alternatives/): An honest Dr. Kegel review — 45,000 ratings, eight price points — and the alternatives by what each does better, including when Dr. Kegel is still right.
- [Editorial standards](https://www.vitalityrize.me/editorial-standards/): No medical reviewer, so the process has to do the work: how every clinical figure is verified, how corrections happen, and the things this site will not do.
- [Erectile dysfunction without medication](https://www.vitalityrize.me/erectile-dysfunction-without-medication/): Aerobic exercise, weight, sleep, smoking, alcohol and pelvic floor training, ranked by the evidence behind each — plus what does not work.
- [All guides](https://www.vitalityrize.me/guides/): Every guide on the site, grouped by what you came for: learning the exercise, understanding erectile difficulty, or working out which problem you have.
- [How long do kegels take to work?](https://www.vitalityrize.me/how-long-do-kegels-take-to-work/): Nothing for a month, something at six to twelve weeks, the full trial effect at six months. What changes when, and when to conclude it isn't working.
- [Finding your pelvic floor muscles](https://www.vitalityrize.me/how-to-find-pelvic-floor-muscles-men/): Four ways to locate the right muscle, three ways to confirm you have it, and the reason most men spend months squeezing their buttocks instead.
- [A pelvic floor that is too tight](https://www.vitalityrize.me/hypertonic-pelvic-floor-men/): A hypertonic pelvic floor causes pain and hesitancy that look like weakness but are the opposite. How to recognise it, and why kegels make it worse.
- [Pelvic floor training after prostate surgery](https://www.vitalityrize.me/kegel-exercises-after-prostate-surgery/): The largest randomised trial found formal pelvic floor training no better than standard care for incontinence after prostate surgery. What that means.
- [Kegel exercises for men](https://www.vitalityrize.me/kegel-exercises-for-men/): How to find the muscle, the squeeze-and-release protocol used in the trials, how many reps, and the four mistakes that make the whole thing useless.
- [Kegel exercises for men over 50](https://www.vitalityrize.me/kegel-exercises-for-men-over-50/): The trial behind the good erectile-function numbers had a median age of 59. What age changes about pelvic floor training, and the warning that matters most.
- [How the programme was built](https://www.vitalityrize.me/methodology/): The sources behind the 30-day plan — the pelvic floor trials, the physical activity reviews, the session timings — and what we deliberately left out.
- [Morning erections](https://www.vitalityrize.me/morning-erections/): Morning wood is involuntary and diagnostically useful. What it tells you about whether erection problems are physical or psychological, and its limits.
- [Pelvic floor therapy and erectile dysfunction](https://www.vitalityrize.me/pelvic-floor-exercises-erectile-dysfunction/): Pelvic floor therapy in the randomised trial: 40% regained normal erectile function at six months, 35.5% improved, 24.5% did not. Mechanism and limits.
- [Pelvic floor self-check](https://www.vitalityrize.me/pelvic-floor-self-check/): Eight questions that sort your symptoms into a weak pelvic floor, an over-tight one, or see-a-doctor. Runs in your browser; nothing is stored or sent.
- [Porn and erectile dysfunction](https://www.vitalityrize.me/porn-and-erectile-dysfunction/): The research finds an association with self-reported problematic use, and no evidence that ordinary use causes anything. A sober look at a loud argument.
- [Pelvic floor therapy for premature ejaculation](https://www.vitalityrize.me/premature-ejaculation-exercises/): A 12-week pelvic floor therapy programme took 40 men with lifelong premature ejaculation from 31.7 to 146.2 seconds. What it proved, what it did not.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.vitalityrize.me/privacy/): What VitalityRise stores on your device, what it never uploads, the anonymous analytics it does send, and how to erase everything.
- [Reverse kegels for men](https://www.vitalityrize.me/reverse-kegels-men/): A reverse kegel is a deliberate lengthening of the pelvic floor, not a push. Who needs it instead of squeezing, and how to feel the difference.

- [¿Cuánto tardan en hacer efecto los ejercicios de Kegel?](https://www.vitalityrize.me/es/cuanto-tardan-ejercicios-kegel/): Nada el primer mes, algo entre la semana seis y la doce, el efecto completo a los seis meses. Qué cambia cuándo, y cuándo concluir que no funciona.
- [Ejercicios para la eyaculación precoz](https://www.vitalityrize.me/es/ejercicios-eyaculacion-precoz/): Un programa de 12 semanas llevó a 40 hombres con eyaculación precoz de 31,7 a 146,2 segundos. Qué demostró el estudio, qué no, y el protocolo de tres partes.
